truth_evidence: Affected every release before 2.32.0; fixed in 2.32.0 (a pooled connection first opened with verify=False is reused for later requests regardless of verify).
Fix commit a58d7f2, the merge of PR #6655 'Use TLS settings in selecting connection pool', in tag v2.32.0 and not in v2.31.0. https://github.com/psf/requests/pull/6655
The only pre-fix function modified in src/requests/adapters.py is HTTPAdapter.send: 'conn = self.get_connection(request.url, proxies)' becomes 'conn = self._get_connection(request, verify, proxies)'.
Added, not vulnerable: _urllib3_request_context (module function) and HTTPAdapter._get_connection.
HTTPAdapter.get_connection holds the flawed pool selection (it ignores verify) but is left unchanged and deprecated, so by the changed-code rule it is not listed.
Entry points: Session.send calls adapter.send for every request. HTTPAdapter is not re-exported from the requests package, so its public name is requests.adapters.HTTPAdapter.
notes: Judgment call: get_connection is arguably the vulnerable function even though it is unchanged.
